datasets.license: CC0 / public domain; retain source citation
datasets.citation: Smith, D. E., et al. (2001). Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter: Experiment summary after the first year of global mapping of Mars. Journal of Geophysical Research: Planets, 106(E10), 23689-23722. https://doi.org/10.1029/2000JE001364
limitations: The gridded DEM includes interpolation between altimetry tracks.
Its approximately 463 m equatorial sampling is coarser than the Earth DEM and must not be visually over-interpreted.
